master_menu.full_description: Shorshe Rui features juicy Rui fish pieces gently cooked in a pungent Bengali mustard sauce, blended with green chilies, mustard oil, and a touch of turmeric. The result is bold, tangy, and silky, with the fish soaking up every bit of the deeply flavorful shorshe.
master_menu.name: Shorshe Rui ( 6 Psc.)
master_menu.short_description: Tender Rui fish in a sharp, aromatic mustard gravy.

master_menu.full_description: Cholar Daal is a classic Bengali delicacy made with chana dal simmered until tender in a fragrant blend of ginger, bay leaf, cinnamon, and cardamom. Finished with coconut and a touch of ghee, it’s rich, lightly sweet, and comforting—perfect alongside luchi or steaming rice.
master_menu.name: Cholar Daal
